# Herend Guide by Paris Tableware

> An independent collector's guide to Herend porcelain figurines (handmade in Herend, Hungary): animals, fishnet colors and item numbers, backstamps, history, care and gifts. Written by Paris Tableware, a family-owned store in Ridgewood, New Jersey, since 1982. Prices and stock are on paristableware.com.

- [Home](https://herend.us/): An independent guide for Herend collectors: hand-painted porcelain animals from Hungary, fishnet colors, item numbers, backstamps, history and care.

## Figurines

- [Herend Animal Figurines: Colors, Codes and Where to Start](https://herend.us/figurines/): How Herend animal figurines are painted, what the fishnet colors are called, how to read the item number, and where to start a collection.
- [Herend Bunny Figurines: How to Choose One](https://herend.us/figurines/bunnies/): A guide to Herend bunny and rabbit figurines: the fishnet colors, miniature to large sizes, Easter and baby gift picks, and how to choose one.
- [Herend Bird Figurines, from Songbirds to Peacocks](https://herend.us/figurines/birds/): Herend bird figurines explained: fishnet songbirds, naturalistic Reserve Collection birds, peacocks and swans, plus how to pick one.
- [Herend Dog Figurines by Breed](https://herend.us/figurines/dogs/): Find your breed in Herend porcelain: Labradors, Dachshunds, Frenchies, Westies, Poodles and more, with the fishnet colors each comes in.
- [Herend Elephant Figurines](https://herend.us/figurines/elephants/): Herend elephant figurines from miniature to showpiece: which models exist, the colors they come in, and why elephants are a popular gift.
- [Herend Cat and Kitten Figurines](https://herend.us/figurines/cats/): Herend cat and kitten figurines in fishnet porcelain: the poses available, the colors they come in, and how to choose one for a cat lover.
- [Herend Owl Figurines](https://herend.us/figurines/owls/): Herend owl figurines from the Owlet to the Gray Barred Owl: fishnet and naturalistic styles, colors, and the Graduation Owl as a gift.
- [Herend Frog Figurines](https://herend.us/figurines/frogs/): A guide to Herend frog figurines: the Frog Prince, yoga frogs, lily pads and pairs, the colors they come in, and gift ideas.
- [Herend Duck Figurines](https://herend.us/figurines/ducks/): Herend duck figurines from playful ducklings to naturalistic mallards, wood ducks and loons: styles, colors and gift ideas.

## Collector guides

- [How to Read Herend Marks and Backstamps](https://herend.us/guides/herend-marks/): What each part of a Herend backstamp means: the factory mark, shape number and decor code, older marks by era, and how to spot a fake.
- [Caring for Herend Figurines, and What to Do When One Breaks](https://herend.us/guides/care-and-replacement/): How to dust, handle, display and pack Herend porcelain figurines, and how to find a replacement by item number when one breaks.
- [Herend History: Where It Is Made and How](https://herend.us/guides/history/): Where Herend porcelain is made, a sourced timeline from 1826 to today, how pieces are fired and painted, and why Herend costs what it does.
- [Herend Gifts for Every Occasion](https://herend.us/guides/gift-guide/): Herend gift ideas by occasion: baby shoes and keepsake boxes, wedding and anniversary pieces, graduation owls and initial letters.
- [Herend at Christmas: Nativity, Snowmen and Holiday China](https://herend.us/guides/christmas/): Herend for the holidays: a nativity you build figure by figure, snowmen, nutcrackers and Christmas trees, plus a short guide to Herend holiday china.

## About this site

- [Who Runs This Guide](https://herend.us/about/): Who runs this Herend guide: Paris Tableware, a family-owned store in Ridgewood, New Jersey, since 1982, selling Herend at paristableware.com.
- [Shipping and Returns](https://herend.us/shipping-returns/): Herend orders ship from Paris Tableware: free over $150, $19 flat below, continental US only. Holiday returns: 30 days on orders through Jan 1, 2027.
- [Privacy and Analytics](https://herend.us/privacy/): What this Herend guide measures, how visits are shared with Paris Tableware, and how to opt out, including Global Privacy Control.
